name: wondelai/skills (Business subset)
description: A multi-domain collection of 50 plus skills; this draft covers the Business subset only, such as create-business, grow-business, and improve-business. The verified sample guides an idea-to-validated-business journey by orchestrating ten phase skills.
install: /plugin marketplace add wondelai/skills plus per-collection plugin installs, and npx skills add wondelai/skills/<name> --global.
